newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Transfield preferred Australia army tenderer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Transfield preferred Australia army tenderer.

text.p: Australian Defence Minister Ian McLachlan announced on Monday that Melbourne-based Transfield Defence Systems was the preferred tenderer for a major upgrade of the army's armoured personnel carriers.
Upgrading the M113 family of vehicles, which includes several components, would ensure they continued to provide effective service until at least 2010, McLachlan said.

"Transfield's offer was selected after detailed evaluation of competing bids from both Australia and overseas and involves a A$30 million project to fit the vehicles with an improved turret and ... electro-optical sight," he said in a statement.
Other components of the upgrade included improved suspension, night vision equipment and a 12.7 mm quick change barrel machine gun.
The first of the 364 modifed vehicles, which were introduced into service in 1964, is scheduled for delivery in early 1998.
